# Robin Farrow

## Overview

- **Age:** 10 years old  <sub>[v5 c8 P0](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0000)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v5 c18 P1](../source/v05-c18.md#nw-v05-c18-p0001)</sub>
- **Origin:** Nova Scotia  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Robin-boy  <sub>[v1 c18 P37](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0037)</sub>; Master Robin  <sub>[v1 c21 P59](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0059)</sub>

## Appearance

Robin is a fair-haired boy covered in fuzzy yellow ringlets, with a snub nose, mischievous hazel eyes, and a perpetually smiling mouth featuring a single dimple in one cheek. He is chubby and energetic, frequently getting covered in mud or dirt. By age ten, he has grown much taller and broader.

_Sources: [v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v1 c18 P28](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0028), [v1 c27 P0](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0000), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c25 P58](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0058)_

## Personality

Robin is an energetic, restless, and endlessly inquisitive boy who is constantly asking questions and getting into mischief. He has a jovial and affectionate nature, though he resists discipline and formality, preferring outdoor play to being tidy. Despite his troublesome pranks, he possesses an engaging charm and a desire to be liked.

_Sources: [v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 c22 P4](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0004), [v1 c27 P0](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0000), [v2 c10 P88](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0088)_

## Goals

- To grow up and become a shopkeeper

## History

Robin was born in Nova Scotia to a family with three sets of twins. After his father died, his mother dissolved the household, and his mother eventually fell ill and passed away. Following her death, Thirza Abernethy brought Robin and his twin sister Lucy to live at Grey Shutters in Brierley. At Grey Shutters, Robin quickly gained a reputation for being full of endless energy, curiosity, and mischief. Over the years, he got into numerous small scrapes, such as locking his sister in a toolhouse, dropping a caterpillar down a girl's neck in church, and putting a toad under Thirza's pillow. Despite these incidents, he formed a deep bond with Nell Harcourt and Thirza, growing steadily under their care into a healthy schoolboy. After his uncle passed away and left a small trust fund for the twins, Thirza formally decided to keep them permanently.

_Sources: [v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v1 c16 P42](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0042), [v1 c18 P29](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0029), [v1 c27 P0](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0000), [v2 c7 P25](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0025), [v2 c8 P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022)_
